comment: Jim Helms is the best professor at this University.  He makes class enjoyable and is the nicest guy at UR.  Helms is the best.  Take all of his classes.
Took every class Jim Helms taught and came away with great information and skills that will carry over in business as well as personal applications. Fantastic teaching skills.
Professor Helms is a wonderful professor!  He is a lot of fun and makes learning fun.  His communication class is very interesting. I felt I took away some valuable information.  Don't miss this one!
Really easy 'A'; He made you interested in communications!
Mr. Helms's class was the most awesome class. His style of teaching was very fun but bore importantly I learned the most from him.
